scripts.text: Someone is giving a speech in a loud voice.
scripts.translation: 有人在用很大的声音发表演讲。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Please take it out of the bag and put it on top of my head.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
请把它从袋子里拿出来，放在我的头上。

scripts.text: Someone is giving a speech in a loud voice.
scripts.translation: 有人在用很大的声音发表演讲。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
I've received a signal that you've arrived at your local coordinates.
Is this the location I called you to?
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
我收到了信号，显示您已到达本地坐标。
这就是我叫您来的地方吗？

scripts.text: Correct
scripts.translation: 正确

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我们到了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think it's here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得这里不对。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
That's odd, but it seems to fit with the information coming from Mini Elly right now, so let's check around.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
这很奇怪，但这似乎与迷你 艾莉目前传来的信息相符，所以我们四处看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Does the guest see anything suspicious?
I've never seen anyone who was neither an intruder nor a guest, but I know that those masked people are suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
客人看到什么可疑的东西了吗？
我从未见过既不是入侵者也不是客人的人，但我知道那些戴面具的人很可疑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those people are residents here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些人都是这里的居民...

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Isn't that an interesting outfit?
I'll remember that.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
那套衣服真有趣。
我会记住的。

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
...No.
We're not talking about peace with your neighbors or anything like that.
What we need is a slightly better future.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
...不。
我们不是在谈论与邻居的和平之类的事情。
我们需要的是一个稍微好一点的未

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
If this isn't repetition, what else can you call it?
How can we ignore this when it's clearly a sign of a divided country?
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
如果这不是重复，那还能叫什么？
当这明显是一个国家分裂的迹象时，我们怎么能忽视它？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
Why did this happen?
Why can't you respect the other person?
I'm sure everyone has their own thoughts, but I'd say this.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
为什么会发生这种事？
为什么你不能尊重他人？
我相信每个人都有自己的想法，但我想说。

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
What does it mean to you as a citizen of this country to entrust all your values to your birth lineage and commit violence against it?
What does it mean to you?
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
作为一个国家的公民，将你的所有价值观托付给你的出生血统并对它施加暴力，这意味着什么？
这对你来说意味着什么？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
Don't you think it's strange to get angry over such a story?
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
你不觉得因为这样的故事而生气很奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
I don't wish for you to fight.
Unless we all come together, we have no future.
scripts.translation:
[发言人]
我不希望你们战斗。
除非我们团结起来，否则我们没有未来。

scripts.text: The speaker continued their speech without paying any attention to the voice from the audience.
scripts.translation: 演讲者继续他们的演讲，没有理会观众席上的声音。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
It's interesting. There are quite a few people wearing masks. It seems like even if we all have the same face like us, we can still distinguish each other.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
这很有趣。有很多人都戴着面具。看来即使我们都有像我们一样的脸，我们仍然可以区分彼此。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Why is this person interrupting someone who is saying the right thing?
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
为什么这个人要打断一个正在说正确事情的人？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because I believe it's not right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因为我相信这是不对的。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
It seems like the fuss is getting louder.
Everyone seems to think they're right and don't want to listen to what anyone else has to say.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
看来骚动越来越大了。
每个人都觉得自己是对的，不想听别人说什么。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
The noise seems to be getting louder than before.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
噪音似乎比刚才更大了。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Priest]
What should we do... Should we intervene?
scripts.translation:
[紧张的牧师]
我们该怎么办...要介入吗？

scripts.text:
The speech knows no end.
The atmosphere around is hostile.
scripts.translation:
演讲没有尽头。
周围的气氛很敌对。

scripts.text:
The speech knows no end.
The unfortunate priest is looking the other way.
scripts.translation:
演讲没有尽头。
不幸的牧师正看向别处。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Someone here gave a speech while wearing a mask?
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
这里有人戴着面具发表演讲？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Don't get me wrong, you outsiders might not know it, but we recognize each other through this half-covered mask.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
别误会，你们这些外人可能不知道，但我们能通过这种半遮面的面具认出彼此。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
He's a brave man, no disguise.
You're probably the only one who can't tell the difference between him and me.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
他是个勇敢的人，没有伪装。
你大概是唯一一个分不清我和他区别的人。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Freya is love.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
芙蕾雅是爱。

scripts.text: Where did the droopy Elly go?
scripts.translation: 垂头丧气的艾莉去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Please take it out of the bag and put it on top of my head.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
请把它从袋子里拿出来，放在我的头上。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Haha, the main gate is that way, adventurer.
You have to climb the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
哈哈，正门在那边，冒险者。
你得爬楼梯上去。

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Maintenance work, as you can see.
...But I'm feeling a little uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
正如你所见，正在维护中。
...但我感觉有点不安。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Hmm. You're an adventurer.
I've been hearing a strange noise coming from the holy ground recently.
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
嗯。你是冒险者。
最近我听到圣地里传来奇怪的声音。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
I think it's because of the accident a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
我想是因为之前的那次事故...

scripts.text: Accident?
scripts.translation: 事故？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
(In a low voice)
There was a tiny accident of mana leakage in there.
The higher-ups are trying to hush it up, but I heard the accident caused some monster emergence.
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
(低声地)
那里发生了一起微小的玛娜泄漏事故。
高层正试图掩盖此事，但我听说事故导致了一些魔物出现。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
My superiors dismissed it as a hogwash,
but listen.
...Can't you hear this strange noise coming from below?
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
我的上级们把这当成胡扯，
但听一下。
...你听不到下面传来的奇怪声音吗？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
If this really is a monster, it means there's a monster trapped in the holy temple, which is a big problem.
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
如果这真的是魔物，那就意味着圣殿里困着一只魔物，这是个大问题。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Oh right! You can get rid of the monster for our goddess!
I'm sure the higher-ups will reprimand me for being indulgent, but I can't turn my eyes away from a monster problem!
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
对了！你可以为我们的女神消灭魔物！
我肯定会被上级责备我多管闲事，但我不能对魔物问题视而不见！

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
We should step up for the pope!
So? Are you up for it?
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
我们应该为教皇挺身而出！
那么，你愿意吗？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
There would be fanatics who went mad and became monsters.
Kill ^4d4dffIsilla, Vanberk, and Hodremlin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
可能会有些狂热者发疯变成了魔物。
消灭^4d4dff依斯拉、凡贝尔克和邪恶妖精^000000。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Grr, I can't just stand by when monsters are rampaging in there...!
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
可恶，我不能眼睁睁看着魔物在里面肆虐...

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Thank you for doing this.
Please be careful.
Take this ventilation shaft. It leads to the place where monsters are running amok.
scripts.translation:
[厄里达努斯]
谢谢你愿意帮忙。
请小心。
请走这个通风管道，它通往魔物肆虐的地方。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] Hold on!! Hey! Can't you see the line? ^e5555eIf you're here to see ^000000Niren^000000, then follow the order!
scripts.translation: [卫兵 登特] 等一下！！ 喂！ 你没看到队伍吗？ ^e5555e如果你要见^000000尼伦^000000，就请遵守秩序！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are really a lot of people.
But it'll be a problem if we don't meet Niren soon.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
人真的很多。
但如果我们再不快点见到尼伦，就会出问题的。

scripts.text: It's said to be an urgent matter.
scripts.translation: 据说这是紧急事务。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] What? I'm in a hurry too, you know?
scripts.translation: [卫兵 登特] 什么？ 我也很赶时间啊。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] Ugh~ Do you even know how many times I've been dispatched to stop fights just today alone?! People keep fighting left and right, and it's driving us crazy too!
scripts.translation: [卫兵 登特] 唉~ 你知道我今天被派去制止了多少次斗殴吗？！ 到处都在打架，这也让我们头疼得要命！

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
They don't even pretend to listen when we try to stop the fights!
They've been fighting over whether they're ^e5555eimmigrants^000000 or ^e5555enatives^000000 for ages, but these days, it's really no joke!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
我们试图制止斗殴时，他们甚至都不装装样子听一下！
他们因为自己是^e5555e移民^000000还是^e5555e原住民^000000而争吵了很久，但最近的情况真的非同小可！

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
They start yEllyng about ^e5555ediscrimination^000000 against natives as soon as we say anything...
Just thinking about it makes my headache.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
只要我们一开口，他们就开始抱怨对原住民的^e5555e歧视^000000...
光是想想就让我头疼。

scripts.text:
[Security Officer Dent]
How have you been lately? Neil?
scripts.translation:
[安保人员 登特]
尼尔，你最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
How have you been lately? Neil?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
尼尔，你最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Sigh~
If only everyone would stop fighting for once...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
唉~
要是大家都能停止打架就好了...

scripts.text: [Guard Neil] Hey, cut it out! But still, you're better than me. You know as well as I do that. I'm a native.
scripts.translation: [卫兵 尼尔] 嘿，别这样！ 不过，你比我强。 你也知道，我是原住民。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Before I even start talking, they tell me to call another security guard from a native.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
我还没开口，他们就说要叫另一个原住民的保安来。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I'm tired of hearing things like 'Do you even know who I am?' when it comes to my native background.
What do they even think the security guard is for!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
听到“你知道我是谁吗”这种话，还涉及我的原住民身份，我受够了。
他们到底觉得保安是干什么的！

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
To be honest, things have been really strange lately.
Even people who never caused these problems before are getting involved in fights, turning small fights into big ones.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
说实话，最近事情真的很奇怪。
连以前从不惹事的人也开始卷入斗殴，把小打小闹变成大冲突。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Exactly!
It's been chaotic everywhere lately.
Now that I think about it, I also came to the temple yesterday.
The priest over there is the one who called me yesterday, right?
How's the temple these days?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
没错！
最近到处都很混乱。
说起来，我昨天也去了神殿。
那里的牧师就是昨天给我打电话的人，对吧？
神殿最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Exactly!
Things have been chaotic everywhere lately.
Come to think of it, I was also at the temple yesterday.
Was the priest there the one who called me yesterday?
How's the temple these days?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
没错！
最近到处都很混乱。
说起来，我昨天也去了神殿。
那里的牧师就是昨天给我打电话的人吗？
神殿最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ah~
Niren seems to be very busy...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
啊~
尼伦看起来非常忙...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Neil, did you happen to see ^e5555eMaram^000000 today?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
尼尔，你今天碰巧看到^e5555e玛拉姆^000000了吗？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Maram?
I think I saw him around the ^e5555eplaza^000000 on my way to the temple earlier...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
玛拉姆？
我刚才去神殿的路上，好像在^e5555e广场^000000附近看到过他...

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I'm not sure if he's still at the plaza, but maybe we could ask the people there to find out where Maram went?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
我不确定他是否还在广场，但也许我们可以问问那里的人，看看玛拉姆去了哪里？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hmm... I see.
The task I asked to {0} earlier, my son Maram will help with that.
He knows more about this matter than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
嗯...我明白了。
我之前拜托{0}处理的事情，我的儿子玛拉姆会协助你。
关于这件事，他比任何人都了解得多。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I would introduce him myself, but as you can see, I can't leave my post right now.
If you ask around ^e5555enear the plaza^000000, you should be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我本想亲自介绍你们认识，但正如你所见，我现在无法离开岗位。
如果你在^e5555e广场附近^000000打听一下，应该能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ugh...
Where could High Priestess Niren have gone...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
唉...
大祭司 尼伦到底去哪儿了...

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
We always pray for the true faith and peace of mind of our believers.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
我们总是为信徒们的真正信仰和内心的平静祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ugh, enough with those scripted greetings~
I saw it myself, what~
And besides, if it's nothing serious, there's no reason for the priest to be standing here like this.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
唉，别念那些套话了~
我都亲眼看到了，真是的~
而且，如果不是什么严重的事情，牧师也没必要像这样站在这里。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Don't we need to know the situation of the people these days so that the security guards can be prepared?
Especially since we don't know much about the situation of people coming to the temple.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
我们不是需要了解最近人们的情况，以便保安做好应对准备吗？
尤其是对于来到神殿的人的情况，我们知之甚少。

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Give us some information~
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
给我们提供一些资讯~

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
The temple is a place for praying for Priest Freya.
With a calm heart...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
神殿是向牧师 芙蕾雅祈祷的地方。
怀着平静的心...

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I saw it yesterday.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Here, in the middle of people fighting each other, this priest with half a mask off...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 尼尔]
我昨天看到了。
<FONT SIZE = 14>这里，就在人们互相打斗的中间，这位牧师半张面具都掉了...</FONT>

scripts.text: [Priest Freya] Oh no!!! Wait a moment! Stop right there!!!
scripts.translation: [牧师 芙蕾雅] 糟糕！！！ 等一下！ 站住！！！

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
<FONT SIZE = 10>Sigh...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
<FONT SIZE = 10>唉...</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Actually...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
其实...

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
It's true that there have been more people causing problems at the temple lately.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
确实，最近神殿里惹事的人变多了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Mostly, they're people venting personal grievances rather than raising official complaints, causing disturbances or shouting at the entrance of the temple.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
大多数情况下，他们是发泄个人恩怨，而不是提出正式投诉，在神殿入口处闹事或大喊大叫。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hold on...
Could we hear more details about this?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
等一下...
能让我们听听更多细节吗？

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
High Priestess Niren!!!!
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
大祭司 尼伦！！！

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Ah, well...
It's been common for people with personal grievances to come to the temple and shout, and we've been trying to calm them down and send them away,
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
啊，好吧...
最近经常有带着个人恩怨的人来到神殿大喊大叫，我们一直在试图安抚他们并让他们离开，

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
But recently, there have been more incidents of physical fights among the people visiting the temple...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
但最近，来访者之间发生肢体冲突的事件越来越多了...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Physical fights in the sacred temple...
Was there no way to resolve their grievances through dialogue?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
在神圣的神殿里发生肢体冲突...
难道就没有办法通过对话来解决他们的矛盾吗？

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Some people, even though we try to reconcile their opinions, accuse us of being heretics and cause disturbances, while others ask how long we will tolerate these heretics. It's not easy for us to resolve these situations.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
有些人，即使我们试图调和他们的意见，也会指责我们是异端并制造骚乱；而另一些人则质问我们要容忍这些异端多久。要解决这些局面并不容易。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
But since they are complaining like that, it seems like they can't complain to Niren directly and take their anger out on the temple.
Because they know how important Niren values harmony
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
但他们既然这样抱怨，看来是无法直接向尼伦投诉，只能把怒火发泄在神殿上。
因为他们知道尼伦多么重视和谐。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sigh...
Heretics...
It seems that our efforts to eliminate discrimination haven't reached their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
唉...
异端...
看来我们消除歧视的努力并没有真正走进他们的心里。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Moreover, causing fights even at the temple is not an issue we can easily overlook.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
而且，在神殿里引发打斗，也不是我们可以轻易忽视的问题。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I've heard some disagreements to some extent, but... I may have been wrong to think that they would naturally resolve if we lived together, got to know each other, and understood each other.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我听说过一些分歧，但...我可能错了，以为只要大家生活在一起，互相了解，就能自然而然地化解这些矛盾。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Even though the hardliners have stepped back, it's not easy for the hearts of those who supported them to change all at once.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
虽然强硬派已经退了一步，但支持他们的人的心意也不可能一下子改变。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sadly, that's true.
The time we waited for self-healing has turned into the result of festering wounds.
Now, even dialogue for reconciliation won't be easy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
令人遗憾的是，事实确实如此。
我们等待自我修复的时间，反而让伤口溃烂了。
现在，即使想要通过对话来和解，恐怕也不容易...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
<FONT SIZE = 10>We need some kind of catalyst...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
<FONT SIZE = 10>我们需要某种催化剂...</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
High Priestess Niren.
How about this adventurer here as a catalyst?
They're a complete outsider.
Well... wouldn't it be possible to at least start a conversation?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
大祭司 尼伦。
不如就让这位冒险者充当催化剂？
他们完全是个局外人。
嗯...至少应该可以开始对话吧？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Anyway, they came here to see you because they have something to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 登特]
总之，他们来这里是因为有话要对您说。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh my...!
{0}!!!
I didn't even notice that {1} was here because I've been so distracted.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
哎呀...！
{0}！！！
我因为心事重重，竟然没注意到{1}在这里。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
As you can see, we're currently swamped with internal issues regarding ^e5555eRachel^000000.
But what is it that you want to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
如您所见，我们目前正忙于处理关于^e5555e拉赫^000000的内部问题。
但您想告诉我什么呢？

scripts.text: About the intruder.
scripts.translation: 关于入侵者。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah...
<FONT SIZE = 10>It's a bit difficult to discuss that here.</FONT>
Please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
啊...
<FONT SIZE = 10>在这里讨论那个有点困难。</FONT>
请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
It seems High Priestess Niren was looking for you. Did you not meet him?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
看来大祭司 尼伦一直在找您。您没有见到她吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}, please follow me this way.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
{0}，请跟我来这边。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
We always pray for the sincere faith and peace of mind of our believers.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 芙蕾雅]
我们总是为信徒们的真诚信念和内心平静祈祷。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It seems there won't be anyone listening here.
^e5555eEspecially on sensitive matters^000000 like this,
I apologize for having to discuss it in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
看来这里没有人会偷听。
^e5555e尤其是在这种敏感问题上^000000，
抱歉，不得不在这样的地方讨论。

scripts.text: Explain about the intruder's identity.
scripts.translation: 解释入侵者的身份。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
<FONT SIZE = 14>That's possible!!!</FONT>
^e5555eHeart Hunters^000000 are already targeting ^e5555eYmir's Heart fragments^000000, so we can't afford to ignore this!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
<FONT SIZE = 14>这是有可能的！！！</FONT>
^e5555e心之猎手^000000已经在盯上^e5555e伊米尔之心碎片^000000了，所以我们不能对此掉以轻心！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
They infiltrated so easily...
We need to immediately ^e5555eStrengthen the security near the Heart Vault^000000 and actively cooperate with ^e5555eRebEllyon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
他们竟然能如此轻易地潜入...
我们需要立即^e5555e加强心之宝库附近的安全措施^000000，并主动与^e5555e叛逆艾利昂^000000合作。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
But no matter how much we reinforce the security near the Heart Vault, with the recent tense atmosphere among the residents, it's actually an ideal situation for intruders to run rampant.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
但无论我们如何加强心之宝库附近的安全，鉴于最近居民之间紧张的气氛，这反而成了入侵者肆意妄为的理想环境。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'll focus on reinforcing the security for now, so could I ask you, {0}, to ^e5555eMediate among the residents^000000?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我目前会专注于加强安保，所以能否请你，{0}，去^e5555e调解居民之间的矛盾^000000？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
No...
Rather than mediating, just listening to their stories and relaying them would be enough.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
不...
与其说是调解，不如说是倾听他们的故事，并将这些情况转达给我就足够了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
When making a decision that I thought would make many people happy, I failed to properly consider the feelings of those who didn't support that choice.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
当我做出一个自认为能让大多数人开心的决定时，却未能充分考虑到那些不支持该选择的人的感受。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It's not realistic to expect everyone to get along overnight.
Just...
If we can understand what the grievances are...
I believe we can start over.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
指望大家一夜之间和睦相处是不现实的。
只是...
如果我们能了解他们的不满所在...
我相信我们可以重新开始。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Right now, it seems like nobody is willing to listen, but like Dent said, perhaps an outsider like {0} might be able to help with the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
目前看来，似乎没有人愿意倾听，但正如丹特所说，也许像{0}这样的局外人能够促进对话。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Human relationships are complicated.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
人际关系真是复杂。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Haha... indeed.
Shall we head back to the entrance of the temple for now?
^e5555eWe need to check with the security^000000 team as well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
哈哈...确实如此。
我们先回到神殿入口吧？
^e5555e我们还需要与安保团队确认情况^000000...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我们先回到神殿入口吧？
^e5555e我们还需要与安保团队确认情况^000000...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm a bit busy right now...
Sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我现在有点忙...
抱歉。

Why would I know where that guy is.
scripts.translation:

什么？

我怎么会知道那家伙在哪里。

scripts.text:

Come to think of it, you!
You're a new face around here...
scripts.translation:

说起来，你！
你看起来是个新面孔...

scripts.text:

Why are you looking for him?
Is there something suspicious going on?

你为什么要找他？
是不是有什么可疑的事情？

scripts.text:

They're not very friendly.
Since they don't seem like they'll tell us where Maram is, let's ask someone else.

他们不太友好。
既然他们似乎不会告诉我们玛拉姆在哪里，我们去问问别人吧。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Villager]
These days, the atmosphere in Rachel seems a bit gloomy.
Is there something going on?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
最近，拉赫的气氛似乎有点阴沉。
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I wonder when Miriam will arrive~
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
不知道米莉亚姆什么时候会到~

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
I believe it's our first meeting. Is this your first time in Rachel?
May the blessings of Freyja be with you, traveler.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
你好。
我想这是我们第一次见面。这是你第一次来拉赫吗？
愿弗蕾雅的祝福与你同在，旅行者。

scripts.text: Deliver Niren's message.
scripts.translation: 转交尼伦的信件

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah!
If it's a task entrusted by my mother, then I must do my best to help!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
啊！
如果是母亲托付的任务，那我一定会全力以赴的！！！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But we don't know much about the situation here. How can we mediate between people?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但我们不太了解这里的情况。我们怎么能在人们之间进行调解呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From my perspective...
Before mediating between people, I hope you understand the situation faced by the natives and our Gray Children.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
从我的角度来看...
在调解人们之前，我希望你能了解原住民和我们灰孩子所面临的处境。

scripts.text: Who are the Gray Children?
scripts.translation: 什么是灰孩子？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Rachel...
It's a city with a beautiful temple now, but it used to be a ^e5555eBarren Wasteland^000000 where the natives lived.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
拉赫...
现在是一座拥有美丽神殿的城市，但以前这里是原住民居住的^e5555e荒芜之地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But one day, ^e5555eFreyja's Disciples^000000 suddenly came and pushed the natives aside, building the temple.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
但有一天，^e5555e弗蕾雅的信徒^000000突然来到这里，将原住民排挤到一边，建造了神殿。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Some people who followed the temple to settle down here tried to live together with the newcomers, but ^e5555emany couldn't bear it and left^000000 or... some ^e5555esuffered^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
一些跟随神殿定居下来的人试图与新来者共同生活，但^e5555e许多人无法忍受而离开了^000000，或者...一些人^e5555e遭受了苦难^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It would have been good if those were just things of the past... but they've ^e5555econtinued until now^000000.
As a result, there are ^e5555echildren who have lost their place to go^000000, and I am one of them.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
如果那些只是过去的事就好了...但它们^e5555e一直持续到现在^000000。
结果，出现了^e5555e失去归属的孩子^000000，我就是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
My adoptive mother, who felt sorry for us, adopted me. And since she became a high-ranking priestess, she has been leading the way in ^e5555eadopting us into the homes of wealthy immigrants^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我的养母同情我们，收养了我。由于她成为了高阶女祭司，她一直引领着^e5555e将我们收养到富裕移民家庭^000000的工作。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Some people found this unacceptable and ^e5555ediscriminated against us^000000, calling us the Gray Children. But my mother hoped that we would become bridges between immigrants and natives.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
有些人认为这不可接受，^e5555e歧视我们^000000，称我们为灰孩子。但我的母亲希望我们能成为移民和原住民之间的桥梁。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>We couldn't fit in anywhere properly, just remained as an outsiders</FONT>.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我们无处容身，只能作为局外人存在</FONT>。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It would be better to hear such stories ^e5555edirectly from people^000000, but...
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
最好能^e5555e直接听当事人讲述^000000这些故事，但是...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I have an ^e5555eimportant appointment with a friend^000000 right now, so could you please allow me to meet my friend and explain the situation later?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我现在有个^e5555e重要的约会^000000，能请您先让我去见一下朋友，稍后再向您解释情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The time we agreed to meet...
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我们约好的时间...

scripts.text:
[???]
It's already been 5 minutes, hasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[???]
已经过了5分钟了吧？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>^e5555eMiriam!</FONT>
Since when have you been here?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>^e5555e米莉亚姆！</FONT>
你什么时候来的？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
But more importantly...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
不过更重要的是...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh!
This is my ^e5555eFriend Miriam^000000.
Miriam, these are {0} and... Elly?
They've come to see me at my mother's request.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
哦！
这是我的^e5555e朋友米莉亚姆^000000。
米莉亚姆，这位是{0}，还有...艾莉？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh!

Miriam, these are {0} and... Elly?

scripts.translation:

哦！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'm sorry, {0} but could we leave after I quickly buy something?
It'll be quick if I just place the order.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
抱歉，{0}，能等我快速买完东西再走吗？
只要下好单就会很快。

scripts.text:
[Maram]

scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah!
{0}, you are here.

scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
啊！
{0}，你来了。
我们需要的人员已经集合了，虽然还差一点。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
When Miriam returns... Oh!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
等米莉亚姆回来...哦！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh!
It's Lord Niren's son!
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
哦！
是尼伦大人的儿子！

scripts.text:
[Maram]

Tamarin, Mark, and Maggi, right?
scripts.translation:

啊，你们是上次来找过我母亲的人。
塔马林、马克和玛姬，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Maram.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
玛拉姆。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Miriam, you're back?
Did you find the clothes?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
米莉亚姆，你回来了？
找到衣服了吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I brought some, but...
Is this enough?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我带了一些，但是...
这样够吗？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hahaha!</FONT>
That outfit, could it be...
It's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>哈哈哈！</FONT>
那套衣服，难道是...
太完美了！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Now that we've gathered all the necessary personnel and prepared the clothes, let me explain the plan.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
既然所需的人员都集合了，衣服也准备好了，让我来解释一下计划。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
We'll wear the clothes brought by Miriam and head to the top of this exotic town to move the goods.
I can't disclose the destination yet, so just follow me.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我们要穿上米莉亚姆带来的衣服，前往这座异国城镇的顶部运送货物。
目前还不能透露目的地，请跟着我就好。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
{0}, please go to the ^e5555estore where you bought the items^000000 and inform them that you will be leaving soon.

scripts.translation:

{0}，请去^e5555e你购买物品的商店^000000，告诉他们我们要出发了。
