scripts.text:
[Miriam]
That probably indicates that the village situation isn't that good.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这大概说明村庄的情况并不太好。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It's difficult to be self-sufficient in this environment.
Even the trees are as hard as rocks.
Or perhaps they're not trees, but rocks?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
在这种环境下想要自给自足很难。
连树木都坚硬得像岩石。
或者它们根本不是树，而是岩石？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I think the situation will improve if we can receive a little help from the outside.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我觉得如果能得到外界的一点帮助，情况会有所改善。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
That would be good if it happens.
Suad may not have said it, but he must have been thinking about it for quite some time.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
如果真能那样就好了。
苏阿德虽然没有明说，但他肯定已经思考这个问题很久了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
And it seems that {0}'s help with purchasing items was effective!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
看来{0}在采购物资方面的帮助很有效！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^e5555eThey may say that entry is only permitted when acquiring supplies^000000, but once they realize that you're ^e5555esomeone trustworthy^000000, they might feel more at ease.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
^e5555e他们可能会说只有采购物资时才允许进入^000000，但一旦他们意识到你是^e5555e值得信赖的人^000000，可能会感到更安心。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
So, shall we start by talking to ^e5555ethe villagers^000000 for now?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
那么，我们要不先和^e5555e村民们^000000聊聊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^e5555eListening to the stories^000000 of the people and getting to know them might reveal ^e5555ethe key to what my mother entrusted^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
^e5555e倾听^000000人们的故事并了解他们，或许能发现^e5555e母亲托付之事的关键^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Thanks to you, I was able to safely pass through ^e5555eOz Labyrinth^000000.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
多亏了你，我才能安全通过^e5555e欧兹迷宫^000000。
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
In the past, as long as I was careful, traveling alone wasn't a big issue. But these days, it's getting harder to go alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
过去只要小心一点，独自旅行并不是大问题。但最近，独自行动变得越来越难了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Considering our village's current situation, I can't always have an escort, and besides, it's risky to attract attention by traveling in a group.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
考虑到我们村庄目前的情况，我不能总是带着护卫，而且成群结队地旅行也会引起注意，很危险。

scripts.text: [Imril] It would be great if we could investigate deeper into Oz Labyrinth. Status of the lava... Distribution of monsters...
scripts.translation: [伊姆里尔] 如果我们能深入调查欧兹迷宫就好了。 熔岩的状况... 魔物的分布...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Adventurer, since you're strong, would you accompany me to ^e5555eOz Labyrinth when you have some free time^000000?
It might be a shameless request, but it's not every day that I have the chance to meet someone as strong as an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
嗯...
冒险者，既然你很强，等你有空的时候，能陪我去^e5555e欧兹迷宫^000000吗？
这也许是个厚脸皮的请求，但能遇到像你这样强大的冒险者，机会可不多。

scripts.text: Depart now!
scripts.translation: 现在出发！

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍后...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Alright!
If you're busy right now, I guess there's nothing to be done.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
好的！
如果你现在很忙，那也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
If you have time later, will you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
如果你之后有空，能和我一起去吗？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Wow!
Really?
You're willingly accepting my request like this? I'm touched!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
哇！
真的吗？
你竟然这么爽快地答应了我的请求？我真的很感动！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then let's meet at ^e5555eOz Labyrinth entrance^000000 first!
You remember the way, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
那我们先在^e5555e欧兹迷宫入口^000000集合吧！
你还记得路吧？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
The monsters that were moving or dealing with lava are obstacles.
It would be great if there were a way to completely eliminate them.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
那些正在搬运货物或处理熔岩的魔物是障碍物。
如果能彻底消灭它们就好了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Ah...
My skin feels prickly.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
啊...
皮肤有点刺痛。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where's the fool who dared to venture deep into the maze with such attire?
Be grateful you're not roasted alive!
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
那个敢穿着这种衣服深入迷宫的笨蛋在哪里？
没被烤熟真是万幸！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, no matter what you say!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
总之，不管你说什么！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, ^e5555eOz Labyrinth situation is getting worse^000000.
^e5555eThe lava area is expanding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
总之，^e5555e欧兹迷宫的情况正在恶化^000000。
^e5555e熔岩区域正在扩大^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
At this rate, there won't be much time left to navigate through Maze of Oz.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
照这样下去，留给我们在欧兹迷宫中行动的时间不多了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Indeed, if the lava has spread to that extent, we need a solution as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
确实，如果熔岩扩散到这种程度，我们需要尽快找到解决方案。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
For now...
To send workers, we need to reduce the number of monsters in Maze of Oz.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
目前...
为了派遣工人，我们需要减少欧兹迷宫中的魔物数量。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou receive a favorable evaluation about you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你获得了良好的评价。^000000

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Monsters that were moving luggage or dealing with lava are obstacles.
It would be great if there were a way to eliminate them completely.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
那些正在搬运货物或处理熔岩的魔物是障碍物。
如果能彻底消灭它们就好了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
What do you say, adventurer?
^e5555eInterested in monster extermination^000000?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
你觉得如何，冒险者？
^e5555e对消灭魔物感兴趣吗^000000？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
You did a great job today. Thank you.
Will you help me tomorrow too?.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
你今天做得很好，谢谢。
明天也愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555ePlease defeat about 20 {0} on the 1st floor of Oz Labyrinth.^000000
Even if the number of monsters decreases slightly, it will greatly help travelers passing through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
^e5555e请在欧兹迷宫1楼击败大约20只{0}。^000000
即使魔物数量减少一点，也能极大地帮助通过迷宫的旅行者。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Stop here.
scripts.translation: 到此为止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Why~? Are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
为什么~？你很忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then be careful on your way back~
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
那回去路上小心~

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555ePlease defeat about 20 {0} on the 1st floor of Oz Labyrinth.^000000
Even if the number of monsters decreases slightly, it will greatly help travelers passing through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
^e5555e请在欧兹迷宫1楼击败大约20只{0}。^000000
即使魔物数量减少一点，也能极大地帮助通过迷宫的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you done already?
Because it's reliable!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
已经完成了吗？
因为很可靠！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
This is still too dangerous, so ^ff0000wait until you're around level 200^000000 to try again!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
这还是很危险，所以^ff0000请等到等级200左右^000000再尝试！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
You did a great job today. Thank you.
Will you help me tomorrow too?.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
你今天做得很好，谢谢。
明天也愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555eDefeat about 20^000000 {0} in the second floor of the maze of Oz.
Because even a small reduction in the number of monsters will be of great help to the hawkers who pass through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
^e5555e在欧兹迷宫2楼击败大约20只^000000{0}。
因为即使魔物数量减少一点，也能极大地帮助通过迷宫的商人。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then be careful and go there~
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
那么请小心，去吧~

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555eDefeat about 20^000000 {0} in the second floor of the maze of Oz.
Because even a small reduction in the number of monsters will be of great help to the hawkers who pass through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
^e5555e在欧兹迷宫2楼击败大约20只^000000{0}。
因为即使魔物数量减少一点，也能极大地帮助通过迷宫的商人。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you done already?
Because it's reliable!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
已经完成了吗？
因为很可靠！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Why~? Are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
为什么~？你很忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Village Boy]
The tournament is about to begin.
It's not a small-scale meeting that happens frequently; it's a tournament where trustworthy people from all around participate!
scripts.translation:
[村里的男孩]
比赛马上就要开始了。
这不是经常举行的小型聚会，而是各地值得信赖的人们都会参加的锦标赛！

scripts.text:
[Village Boy]
<NAVI>[Over there]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is where you should go. There's a spot for the adventurer too.
Of course, now that you're an adventurer, you're someone we can trust.
scripts.translation:
[村里的男孩]
<NAVI>[那边]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>就是你要去的地方。那里也有冒险者的位置。
当然，既然你是冒险者，就是我们可以信赖的人。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
The meeting is about to start! Not just any meeting, but a competition!
<NAVI>[People]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> They're gathered together. Adventurers, go quickly!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
会议马上就要开始了！不是普通的会议，而是比赛！
<NAVI>[人们]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>他们聚集在一起了。冒险者，快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
In our village, meetings are held frequently. Everyone gathers to share their opinions at those times.
But competitions are different! It's a really important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
在我们村子里，经常举行聚会。大家都会聚在一起分享意见。
但比赛不一样！那是非常重要的场合！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Of course, not just anyone can participate.
They said only trustworthy friends from the village can join.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
当然，不是谁都能参加的。
他们说只有村里值得信赖的朋友才能加入。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Can adventurers participate in the event too?
Well, that's up to you, the adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
冒险者也能参加这个活动吗？
嗯，这取决于你，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
You have arrived. The business of 'Bearded Jack' is a hardware store.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
你来了。“大胡子 杰克”的生意是一家五金店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Welcome. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
欢迎光临。有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
When it comes to kitchen knives and pots, there's no place like our shop in Rachel.
Take your time looking around.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
说到厨刀和锅具，拉赫没有哪家店比得上我们。
请慢慢看。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Uh, we came looking for something a little different.
What was that, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
呃，我们想找点不一样的东西。
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Smelly Sock
scripts.translation: 臭袜子

scripts.text: Smelly Dandelion
scripts.translation: 臭蒲公英

scripts.text: Scented Sock
scripts.translation: 香袜子

scripts.text: Scented Dandelion
scripts.translation: 香蒲公英

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Hmm, I don't think that was it.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
嗯，我觉得不是那个。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Why would you find such dirty things in our store?
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
你为什么会在我们店里找这么脏的东西？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, look who's finally arrived.
Did you come to check out the place where the fragrant dandelions bloom?
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
哎呀，你终于来了。
你是来参观香蒲公英盛开的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Go to Veins. You'll find me there.
In a corner of Veins Village, there's a weapon merchant that not many people know about.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
去伯仁斯。你会在那里找到我。
在伯仁斯村的一个角落，有一家鲜为人知的武器商店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
If anyone asks who recommended you, just say it's Jack's recommendation, of course.
They're probably just doing business for a short time so they can hit and run quickly. so if you're too late, they won't deal with you
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
如果有人问是谁推荐你的，就说当然是杰克的推荐。
他们可能只是短期做生意，所以会很快收摊。如果你来晚了，他们就不会接待你了。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, after connecting to <NAVI>[Weapon Shop]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> it's not under my jurisdiction anymore.
Well then, give it your best shot.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
好吧，既然你连接到了<NAVI>[武器商店]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，那就不归我管了。
那么，加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Um, I don't think it was.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
嗯，我觉得不是那个。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
No, our store is a hardware store, not a laundry.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
不，我们的店是五金店，不是洗衣店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, <NAVI>[Weapon Merchant]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is not under my jurisdiction since you linked it.
Then do your best.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
好吧，既然你连接到了<NAVI>[武器商人]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，那就不归我管了。
那么，加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Welcome. This is 'Bearded Jack' hardware store.
We sell very well-made kitchen knives and pots.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
欢迎光临。这里是“大胡子 杰克”五金店。
我们出售做工精良的厨刀和锅具。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
My name? Of course, it's Bearded Jack.
This store is all mine!
scripts.translation:
[大胡子 杰克]
我的名字？当然是大胡子 杰克。
这家店全是我的！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello~
Are you in business?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
你好~
你们在营业吗？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
We're closed.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
我们已打烊。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Don't be like that. I came here because Jack introduced me, saying there are smelly dandelions here.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
别这样。我是杰克介绍来的，他说这里有臭臭的蒲公英。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Who is it, Dandelion, who is it!
hich jerk came up with such a strange password!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
我是谁，蒲公英，我是谁！
是哪个混蛋想出了这么奇怪的密码！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, your name is... So, it was Dandelion.
For something related to security, it's quite simple, isn't it.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
啊，你的名字是...所以，是蒲公英。
作为安全措施来说，这太简单了，不是吗。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Anyway, what's going on!
If you came to buy weapons, just take what you need without hesitation.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
总之，有什么事！
如果你是来买武器的，尽管拿你需要的，不用犹豫。

scripts.text: I came here to buy some weapons...
scripts.translation: 我来这里买些武器...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Right? What the adventurer is saying is correct.
Rather than coming to buy one or two weapons, it's more like a bulk purchase, shall we say?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
对吧？冒险者说得对。
与其说是买一两件武器，不如说是批量采购，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Bulk purchase? How much are you planning to buy?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
批量采购？你打算买多少？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Well, roughly this much?
Is this amount acceptable at this store?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
嗯，大概这么多？
这个数量在这家店可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Gulp, th-that much? Are you suggesting war?
W-well, if you give me a little time, it seems possible.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
咕，那...那么多？你是在暗示要开战吗？
那...好吧，如果给我一点时间，似乎也是可能的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What should we do? We don't have much time.
I hope we can find it as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我们该怎么办？我们没有太多时间。
希望能尽快找到。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Call your schedule. I'll try to accommodate as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
叫你的日程。我会尽快安排。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's good too, but how about connecting us directly with the supplier?
We'll take care of the intermediary fees without any inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
那样也好，但为什么不直接把我们和供应商连接起来？
我们会处理中间费用，不会给你添麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Hey! Who's revealing the background while doing business!
Enough, go back, go back!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
嘿！做生意的时候谁在暴露背景啊！
够了，回去，快回去！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hey, who are you kidding? I already know everything. Selling this at such a special price is just a flashy business strategy, right?
Anyway, we're not going to have a long-term business relationship, are we?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
嘿，你在逗谁呢？我什么都知道了。以这种特价出售，不过是一种花哨的商业策略罢了，对吧？
总之，我们不会建立长期的商业关系，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
So, I'm just asking for a bit of information from your end.
Whether it's our urgent situation or the guy taking off the intermediary fee, either works. Isn't it a win-win?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
所以，我只是想从你这里打听一点消息。
无论是我们紧急的情况，还是那个拿走中间费的人，都行。这不是双赢吗？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Mmm... Alright. But absolutely do not leak it.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
嗯...好吧。但绝对不要泄露出去。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Such obvious words.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
真是显而易见的话。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
It's the Thor Volcano. Deep inside, there's a secret base, and the weapons come from there.
I'm letting you know because once their stock there runs out, the deal is going to be cut off anyway.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
是索尔火山。深处有一个秘密基地，武器就是从那来的。
我告诉你，是因为等那里的库存用完，交易自然就会断绝了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From the way you're talking, it seems like you'll cut ties soon, huh?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
听你说话的语气，看来你很快就会切断联系，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Kid, don't try to float around more. Find out the rest yourself.
If you've got what you wanted, pay the commission and leave.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
小鬼，别想再套我的话了。剩下的自己去查。
既然得到了你想要的，就付佣金然后离开。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Thor Volcano's secret base... this smells very suspicious.
I have a feeling this might be our final destination, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
索尔火山的秘密基地...这闻起来非常可疑。
我有种感觉，这里可能就是我们的最终目的地，你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'll see you at <NAVI>[Thor Volcano]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> Make sure to come prepared!
Don't enter the military base directly; instead, come in the direction of 3 o'clock from there, and I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我在<NAVI>[索尔火山]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>等你。一定要做好准备！
不要直接进入军事基地；而是从那里3点钟方向过来，我会在那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Kid, don't try to float around more. Find out the rest yourself.
If you've got what you wanted, pay the commission and leave.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
小鬼，别想再套我的话了。剩下的自己去查。
既然得到了你想要的，就付佣金然后离开。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'll see you at<NAVI>[Thor Volcano]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> Make sure to come prepared!
Don't enter the military base directly; instead, come in the direction of 3 o'clock from there, and I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我在<NAVI>[索尔火山]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>等你。一定要做好准备！
不要直接进入军事基地；而是从那里3点钟方向过来，我会在那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Over here! Follow me!
Here's a <NAVI>[shortcut]<INFO>que_thr,133,53,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that will take you around a bit, but it'll keep you out of sight.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
这边！跟我来！
这里有一个<NAVI>[捷径]<INFO>que_thr,133,53,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，虽然会绕一点路，但可以避开视线。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Oh? Suad! Miriam and Maram are here too.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
哦？苏阿德！米莉亚姆和玛拉姆也在这里。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
What's going on, everyone? If it's about the weapons, I've already said everything before.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
大家怎么了？如果是关于武器的事，我之前已经说过了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Is there something else that needs to be said besides that?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
除了那些，还有别的需要说的吗？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Hey~ that's scary~ Why all of a sudden? Bringing in strangers too. Is there something to be afraid of?
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
嘿~真吓人~怎么突然这样？还带了陌生人来。有什么好怕的？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What nonsense is this? I'm more afraid of you guys! How can you attack the upper ranks?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
这是什么胡话？我更怕你们！你们怎么能攻击上级？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Oh, that? You don't have to praise me.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
哦，那个？你不用夸我。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Really~Ah?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
真是的~啊？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We came to hear the reason why you attacked the innocent upper ranks.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我们来听听你们攻击无辜上级的原因。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
What's this about? You've all gathered here over something trivial?
scripts.translation:
[坤]
这是怎么回事？大家为了这么点小事聚在一起？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Something trivial? Because of what you've done, we're being branded as rebels. You've given them an excuse to attack us!
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
小事？因为你们做的事，我们被扣上了反叛的帽子。你们给了他们攻击我们的借口！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
If they attack us, we'll just counterattack. What's there to worry about? We have weapons now too, you know?
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
如果他们攻击我们，我们就反击。有什么好担心的？我们现在也有武器了，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Do you know who we robbed? If you knew, you'd thank us. It wasn't an innocent upper rank, you know?
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
你知道我们抢了谁吗？如果你知道，你会感谢我们的。那可不是无辜的上级，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Do you know what it's called when you attack and rob the upper ranks regardless of innocence? It's called robbery.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你知道不管对方是否无辜，攻击并抢劫上级的行为叫什么吗？那叫抢劫。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
No, this is too much. Robbery? We targeted Ahmad's upper ranks.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
不，这太过分了。抢劫？我们针对的是艾哈迈德的上级。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
If it's Ahmad...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
如果是艾哈迈德...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Isn't it Suad's?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
那不是苏阿德的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Yeah! They treated us like trash and even ignored their own sons!
scripts.translation:
[坤]
是啊！他们把我们当垃圾，甚至无视自己的儿子！

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
They were sucking people like us dry!
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
他们一直在压榨我们这样的人！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Isn't it a good thing that we sought revenge on Suad and secured the necessary supplies?
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
我们向苏阿德复仇并获得了必要的物资，这不是好事吗？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Exactly!! You suffered a lot because of your father. You came here because of him.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
没错！！你因为你父亲受了很多苦。你因为他才来到这里的。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Simply because you're indigenous, he not only refused to acknowledge you as a capable son but also subjected you to abuse. In fact, he probably never even acknowledged you as his son.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
仅仅因为你是原住民，他不仅不承认你是有能力的儿子，还虐待你。事实上，他可能从未承认过你是他的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Is there anyone here who doesn't know Suad's story??
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
这里有人不知道苏阿德的遭遇吗？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
You always imagined it in your heart, right? You didn't deserve such treatment. You wanted revenge against your stepfather.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
你心里一直这么想，对吧？你不应该受到这样的对待。你想向你的继父复仇。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Say something, Suad.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
说点什么吧，苏阿德。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
...Sigh... Alright, I understand... Just... Let's be careful next time. I understand why you did what you did, but we could end up in even bigger trouble...
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
...唉...好吧，我明白了...只是...下次小心点。我理解你们为什么这么做，但我们可能会陷入更大的麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad? Is that the end of it?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
苏阿德？就这样结束了？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I may not know much about this kind of thing, but from my limited perspective, won't they continue like this in the future? Shouldn't we arm ourselves just in case?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我可能不太懂这种事，但从我的角度来看，他们以后还会这样吧？我们是不是应该武装自己以防万一？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Given the shortage of supplies in the village, that's true. It's becoming increasingly difficult for trade.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
考虑到村庄物资短缺，这是真的。贸易变得越来越困难了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
And as I mentioned before, being armed is necessary. We'll need to find new sources while keeping what we've already acquired. That's why I wanted to discuss it with you all
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
正如我之前所说，武装自己是必要的。我们需要在保留现有物资的同时寻找新的来源。所以我才想和大家讨论这件事。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad? Tell us. Are you completely unaware of this decision? Can you honestly say you have no involvement in this matter?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
苏阿德？告诉我。你完全不知道这个决定吗？你能诚实地说这件事与你毫无关系吗？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Wait, wait. I need some time to gather my thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
等等，等等。我需要时间整理一下思绪。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！ -
- 您当前携带的物品 -
- 数量过多。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再次尝试。 -

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The damage... is too great.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
损失...太大了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Moreover, with the bloodshed that occurred, rumors of a native uprising will spread in no time. It's already a bad situation with the headquarters attack incident.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
而且，由于发生了流血事件，原住民起义的谣言很快就会传开。加上之前总部的袭击事件，情况已经够糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Don't worry about public opinion. Let us handle the recovery.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
别担心舆论。恢复工作交给我们处理。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It turns out that recent events were all part of a scheme.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
看来最近发生的一切都是某个阴谋的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
It was our oversight not to examine the suspicious movements within the temple more closely.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
是我们疏忽了，没有更仔细地调查寺庙内的可疑动向。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Let's save self-blame for later and focus on resolving the situation on both sides for now.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
自我责备的事以后再说吧，现在先集中精力解决双方的局势。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Are we sure about the involvement of the Youth Amal Vice-Chancellor?
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我们确定青年阿马尔的副议长参与其中吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
After the setback, my deputy, who had been languishing, suddenly regained vigor and became enthusiastic. Since then, tensions between the natives and immigrants of Arunafeltz have gradually escalated.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
在遭遇挫折后，一直萎靡不振的副手突然恢复了活力，变得积极起来。从那以后，阿鲁纳菲兹的原住民与移民之间的紧张局势逐渐升级。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
That aligns roughly with the time when the Heart Hunters escaped from the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
这大致与心之猎手从宅邸逃脱的时间吻合。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
It seems certain that they conspired together after all.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
看来他们确实是一起合谋的。

scripts.text: Because I even witnessed it.
scripts.translation: 因为我亲眼目睹了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
One thing that's troubling is that the Vice-Chancellor of Youth Amal wouldn't be unaware of the value of the Imir's Heart Fragment. Simply causing conflict by infiltrating the organization wouldn't have been enough to easily betray it...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
令人担忧的是，青年阿马尔的副议长不可能不知道伊米尔之心碎片的价值。仅仅通过潜入组织制造冲突，不足以让他轻易背叛...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Did they agree to receive something more and hand it over?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
他们是否约定了接收更值钱的东西并交出来？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I'm not sure, but my deputy... No, I need to go and confirm it myself.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我不确定，但我的副手...不，我需要亲自去确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where are you going? Do you have any idea where to start looking?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
你要去哪里？你有头绪从哪里开始查吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
There's a summer villa on the outskirts of Rachel. Recently, my deputy has been frequenting that place for medical treatment. If he's colluding with those mad scientists to plan something, that's probably where he'd be.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
拉赫郊外有一栋夏季别墅。最近，我的副手经常去那里接受治疗。如果他和那些疯狂科学家勾结策划什么，那里很可能就是他的藏身之处。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
We'll need to do some tracking.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
我们需要进行追踪。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Tracking down the person who stole the Heart Fragment should be left to Miriam. I hope the adventurer will accompany her.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
追踪窃取心之碎片的人这件事，应该交给米莉亚姆。希望冒险者能陪同她。

scripts.text: Understood.
scripts.translation: 明白了

scripts.text:
[Zed]
We'll stay here to attend to the injured and identify any remaining stragglers who might still be around. We also need to consider public opinion.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
我们留在这里照顾伤员，并排查可能仍潜伏在附近的漏网之鱼。我们还需要考虑舆论的影响。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We need to return to the forest and handle the aftermath there as well.
Miriam, adventurer. Then I entrust you with tracking.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我们需要回到普勒斯特处理那里的善后工作。
米莉亚姆，冒险者。那么，追踪的任务就交给你们了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Let's go, adventurer. Before heading to the villa, there's someone who will accompany us. Let's meet at <NAVI>[������ �̷�]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
走吧，冒险者。在前往别墅之前，还有一个人会陪同我们。我们在<NAVI>[奥兹迷宫]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>会面

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We agreed to meet Miriam at <NAVI>[Maze of Oz]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我们约定在<NAVI>[奥兹迷宫]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>与米莉亚姆会面

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
The situation here is not so good these days.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
最近这里的情况不太妙。

scripts.text:
Arrived at the meeting place.
It seems like the others haven't arrived yet.
Let's wait.
scripts.translation:
已到达约定地点。
其他人似乎还没到。
先等等吧。

scripts.text: Were you waiting for Miriam?
scripts.translation: 你在等米莉亚姆吗？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I asked for my mother's permission and came out for a moment.
I'm in the middle of handling the protest so I have to go back soon but...
Where is Miriam?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
我征得母亲的同意后出来透口气。
我正忙着处理抗议活动，得赶紧回去，但是...
米莉亚姆在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
There she comes.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
她来了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Sorry for being late. I took some time to find someone.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
抱歉来晚了。我花了一些时间找人。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
This is Ira.
She's a child who often brings my father's books, but she needs help to enter the villa.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这是艾拉。
她经常帮我父亲送书，但她需要帮助才能进入别墅。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What, why is Ira here?
Is she related to this matter?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
什么，艾拉怎么会在这里？
她和这件事有关吗？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Long time no see, Maramoppa.
I came to repay a favor to Miriam unnie while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
好久不见，玛拉姆欧帕。
我顺便来帮米莉亚姆欧尼的忙。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
You said there's something to see at the villa?
I've been pushing Sir Amal's wheelchair around, so I've been everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
你说别墅里有东西要看？
我最近一直推着阿马尔大人的轮椅到处走，所以那里我都去过。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Coincidentally, I have the keys for the servants. I haven't returned them yet because I've been accompanying Sir Amal recently.
Even recently, I haven't returned them as I've been out with Sir Amal.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
巧的是，我有仆人的钥匙。因为最近一直陪阿马尔大人，所以还没还回去。
最近我也没还，因为我一直和阿马尔大人在一起。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
And about that villa.
Sometimes we lend it to the priests.
That's what happened this time too.
But it's a bit strange.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
还有那栋别墅。
有时候我们会借给牧师们住。
这次也是那样。
但有点奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Strange?
It would be good if you could be specific.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
奇怪？
如果能具体说明就好了。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
They said some priests would be staying for a while, but it feels like a lie...
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
他们说会有几位牧师住一段时间，但感觉像是谎言...

scripts.text:
[Ira]
It seems like Sir Amal is operating another secret group.
Last time, he said he'd wage war but got pushed out of the temple, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
看来阿马尔大人又在运作什么秘密组织了。
上次他说要发动战争，结果被赶出了神殿，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
It seems like he hasn't given up yet.
This time, there seem to be more dangerous people staying at the villa than last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
看来他还没死心。
这次，别墅里住的人似乎比上次更危险。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
I don't care who, but I wish someone would stop him.
The atmosphere is not good either.
If there's a war, we, the indigenous people, will be the ones caught in the crossfire.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
不管是谁，我都希望有人能阻止他。
气氛也很不好。
如果爆发战争，我们原住民就会成为夹在中间的受害者。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Well... no, it won't be a war.
You can relax, it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
嗯...不，不会发生战争的。
你可以放心，没问题的。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Sister! How can you be so calm?
Do you know how scary it was for me to manage the villa?!
Especially with that strange woman there...
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
修女大人！你怎么能这么冷静？
你知道管理那栋别墅有多可怕吗？！
特别是那个奇怪的女人...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hahaha....
Alright, calm down, Ira.
We're gathered here to figure that out now.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
哈哈...
好了，冷静点，艾拉。
我们聚在这里就是为了弄清楚这件事。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
For that reason, we're planning to enter the villa where aggressive guests are staying.
Since they seem to be the same people we encountered at the temple.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
正因如此，我们计划进入那栋有激进客人居住的别墅。
因为他们似乎就是我们在神殿遇到的那些人。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
I understand what you mean.
Honestly, I'd like to go with you.
But there are still things I need to take care of.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我明白你的意思。
说实话，我也想和你们一起去。
但我还有些事情需要处理。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Yeah. I hurriedly asked for permission and left for a moment.
I still need to handle the protest and do some coordination work.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
是啊。我匆忙请了假出来一会儿。
我还需要处理抗议活动，做一些协调工作。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Sorry, but Suadand I won't be able to go with you..
Can you understand?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
抱歉，苏阿德和我无法和你们一起去了。
你能理解吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Of course.
It's better for you to handle matters among yourselves.
I'll rely on the people of the Wolf Village.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
当然。
你们处理内部事务更好。
我会依靠狼村的人。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Then, {0}, will you scout the villa with us?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
那么，{0}，你愿意和我们一起侦察别墅吗？

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交给我吧

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Thank you for understanding.
If you safely enter the villa, we'll bring Ira with us.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
谢谢你的理解。
如果你能安全进入别墅，我们会带上艾拉。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Thank you.
Then, Ira. Will you send us to the villa?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
谢谢。
那么，艾拉。你能送我们去别墅吗？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Of course.
Just talk to me when you're ready.
I'll send you right away.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
当然可以。
准备好了就告诉我。
我会立刻送你们过去。

scripts.text:
You can enter the MD Memorial's villa story mode.
Adventurers who have already completed it can only enter to accompany fellow adventurers.
Would you like to enter together for your companion?
scripts.translation:
你可以进入记忆地下城的别墅剧情模式。
已经完成的冒险者只能进入以陪伴其他冒险者。
你想和你的同伴一起进入吗？

scripts.text: Enter the {0}
scripts.translation: 进入 {0}

scripts.text: ^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000
Accompanying is not currently possible. Please check if your accompanying party member has applied for MD.
scripts.translation: 目前无法进行陪伴。请检查你的陪伴队伍成员是否已申请记忆地下城。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000只有队伍成员才能进入记忆地下城。^000000

scripts.text:
[Temple Knight]
The Sanctuary Sethrumnir.
The general chapel is not here, so please go back.
scripts.translation:
[神殿骑士]
这里是圣所塞特鲁姆尼尔。
这里没有普通礼拜堂，请回去。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Phew... It's hot!
It used to be a cool cave...
Now, just standing still feels like sweat is pouring down.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
呼...好热！
这里以前是个凉爽的洞穴...
现在，光是站着不动就感觉汗水直流。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
If we stay too long, I might get dizzy, so let's explore quickly.
For now, this path is an ^e5555eexternal path^000000, so we just need to walk straight.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
如果待太久，我可能会头晕，所以我们得快点探索。
目前，这条路是^e5555e外部通道^000000，我们只需要直走即可。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Someone left their luggage behind.
Sometimes when facing monsters or feeling too exhausted to carry items, people hide their luggage like this and move on.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
有人把行李落在这里了。
有时候，当人们面对魔物或因为太累而无法携带物品时，就会像这样把行李藏起来，然后继续前进。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
While it's important to move items, life is precious.
Since we're close to the entrance here, it's convenient to retrieve the items later.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
虽然搬运物品很重要，但生命更宝贵。
既然离入口很近，之后回来取物品也很方便。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's leave this luggage for now and move on.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
先把行李留在这里，我们继续前进吧。

scripts.text: - A box has been left unattended. -
scripts.translation: - 有一个箱子被遗忘了。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
The path here is rough, so be careful.
You might slip and hurt your ankle if you're not careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
这里的路很崎岖，请小心。
如果不注意，可能会滑倒伤到脚踝。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's go down straight from here.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
从这里直接往下走吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hoo!
It's hot!
Steam is escaping from the cracked crevice.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
呼！
好热！
裂缝里正冒出蒸汽。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Fortunately, the ground seems okay for now, but steam rising indicates that the ground deep below has heated up, so we might not be able to go much further before lava starts flowing.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
幸好地面目前看起来还安全，但蒸汽上升表明深处的地面已经升温，我们可能走不了多远，熔岩就会开始流动。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
It's really serious that it's starting to heat up near the main path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
主路附近开始升温，情况真的很严重...

scripts.text: [???] Imril!!
scripts.translation: [???] 伊姆里尔！！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you okay, Paul?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
你没事吧，保罗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Haha...
I got hit by hot steam while running away from monsters.
I let my guard down on the path I always took.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
哈哈...
我在逃离魔物时被热蒸汽击中了。
在我常走的路径上，我一时大意了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I'm not sure where my belongings went either.
Getting hurt and losing my belongings, it's miserable...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我也不确定我的物品掉在哪里了。
受伤又丢了东西，真是惨透了...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Don't say that, your life is more important than your belongings.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
别这么说，你的生命比物品更重要。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Yeah...
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
是啊...
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
I have some potions here, so drink this and return to the village first.
You can find your belongings later.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
我这里有一些药水，喝下去然后先回村庄吧。
你可以之后再去找你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
No, keep it!
We can't waste the village's valuable resources like this.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
不，留着吧！
我们不能这样浪费村庄宝贵的资源。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Rest for a while, then go back to the village and apply ointment.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
休息一会儿，然后回村庄涂药膏吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Still, I don't want to get hit by monsters while recovering, so can you help me ^e5555eclean up the monsters nearby^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
不过，我不想在恢复期间被魔物攻击，你能帮我^e5555e清理一下附近的魔物^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Rest for a while, then go back to the village and apply ointment.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
休息一会儿，然后回村庄涂药膏吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Still, I don't want to get hit by monsters while recovering, so can you help me ^e5555eclean up the monsters nearby^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
不过，我不想在恢复期间被魔物攻击，你能帮我^e5555e清理一下附近的魔物^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Phew~
Thanks!
I'm feeling a bit better now and can move.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
呼~
谢谢！
我现在感觉好多了，可以活动了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Well, I'll slowly head back to the village now.
It's good to investigate the maze, but be careful of your health.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
好了，我要慢慢回村庄了。
探索迷宫虽然不错，但也要注意身体健康。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Take care, Paul.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
知道了。
保重，保罗。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Steam rising from various places is indeed a big problem, not just the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
嗯...
各处升腾的蒸汽确实是个大问题，不仅仅是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Travelers rarely descend further down, but if they are chased by monsters, they might take the wrong path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
旅行者很少会深入下去，但如果被魔物追赶，可能会走错路...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's ^e5555ego down a bit more^000000 for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
让我们^e5555e再往下走一点^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Well, I'll slowly head back to the village now.
It's good to investigate the maze, but be careful of your health.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
好了，我要慢慢回村庄了。
探索迷宫虽然不错，但也要注意身体健康。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Take care, Paul.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
知道了。
保重，保罗。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Steam rising from various places is indeed a big problem, not just the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
嗯...
各处升腾的蒸汽确实是个大问题，不仅仅是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Travelers rarely descend further down, but if they are chased by monsters, they might take the wrong path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
旅行者很少会深入下去，但如果被魔物追赶，可能会走错路...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's ^e5555ego down a bit more^000000 for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
让我们^e5555e再往下走一点^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
There's some luggage here too...
Could this be the luggage Paul lost?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
这里也有一些行李...
这难道是保罗丢失的行李？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's just remember the location for now and retrieve it later.
We still need to check ^e5555efurther down^000000.
This way...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
先记住位置，之后再回来取吧。
我们还需要检查^e5555e更深处^000000。
这边...

scripts.text: - The box is left unattended. -
scripts.translation: - 箱子无人看管。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Ugh...
The heat is already unbearable.
It's even more dangerous down here, so we really need to be careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
唉...
热得已经让人难以忍受了。
下面更加危险，我们必须格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
To be honest, unless you're as strong as an adventurer, coming this far is as good as a death sentence.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
说实话，除非你有冒险者那样的实力，走到这里几乎就等于判了死刑。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
But since I'm here with you, I'll venture further down.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
不过既然我陪在你身边，我就继续往下探索。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
It seems like the monsters down here have slightly changed their form just from coming down a bit further.
Even this level of change could pose a risk to adventurers, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
看来下面的魔物稍微深入一点，形态就发生了一些变化。
即使只是这种程度的变化，对冒险者来说也可能构成威胁，你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Since it's too dangerous here, let's just take a quick look around and then head back to town.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
这里太危险了，我们快速查看一下周围，然后回城镇吧。

scripts.text: [Imril] Elder!!!! You're safe!!!
scripts.translation: [伊姆里尔] 长老！！ 你没事吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
No.
Who is this?
Isn't this Imril?
Why did you come to such a dangerous place?
scripts.translation:
[长老]
不。
这是谁？
这不是伊姆里尔吗？
你为什么来到这么危险的地方？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
No, why are you really here, Elder.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
不，您为什么真的在这里，长老。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
The maze master is in the maze, where else would I be.
scripts.translation:
[迷宫大师长老]
迷宫大师在迷宫里，还能在哪里呢。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
But this place is too dangerous with monsters...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
但这里魔物太多，太危险了...

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Well, it's not only here, so don't worry.
With all the noise the monsters are making these days, I thought there might be someone in danger and came down to check.
scripts.translation:
[迷宫大师长老]
嗯，不仅仅是这里，所以别担心。
最近魔物动静很大，我担心有人遇到危险，就下来查看了一下。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
I've told Suad that the lava has reached this far, and below here, the ground has already melted a lot, making it even more dangerous, so don't go down.
scripts.translation:
[迷宫大师长老]
我已经告诉苏阿德，熔岩已经蔓延到这里了。再往下的地面已经融化了很多，更加危险，所以不要下去。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
If it were an adventurer next to you, it might be okay, but it's too dangerous for you.
scripts.translation:
[迷宫大师长老]
如果是和你在一起的冒险者，或许还可以，但对你来说太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Please take care of yourself, Elder.
Hurry back to the village.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
明白了。
请保重身体，长老。
快回村庄吧。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Oh my~
If the maze master isn't in the maze, who will manage the maze!
scripts.translation:
[迷宫大师长老]
哎呀~
如果迷宫大师不在迷宫里，谁来管理迷宫呢！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, stubbornness...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
真是固执...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
As Inspirational said, I don't think I can handle going further down, so let's go back to the ^e5555evillage^000000.
I feel like my skin is burning even now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
正如鼓舞所说，我觉得我无法再往下走了，我们回^e5555e村庄^000000吧。
现在我的皮肤感觉都要烧起来了。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Oh my~
If the maze Master isn't in the maze, who will manage the maze!
scripts.translation:
[迷宫大师长老]
哎呀~
如果迷宫大师不在迷宫里，谁来管理迷宫呢！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, you're so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
真是固执...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
As the elder said, I don't think I can go down any further, so let's go back to ^e5555eVillage^00000.
Even now, my skin feels like it's going to burn.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里尔]
正如长老所说，我觉得我无法再往下走了，我们回^e5555e村庄^00000吧。
现在我的皮肤感觉都要烧起来了。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！ -
- 您当前携带的物品 -
- 数量过多。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再次尝试。 -

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh my, look at him breathing. Isn't our little pup just adorable?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哎呀，看它呼吸的样子。我们的小狗真可爱啊？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Hey, buddy, it's time for you to learn a foreign language too...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
嘿，巴迪，你也该学学外语了...

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh my, look at this! Look at the way they're breathing. They're a genius at inhaling and exhaling! A true genius!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哎呀，看这个！看它们呼吸的样子。它们是呼吸的天才！真正的天才！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello! Scania!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
你好！斯堪尼亚！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Maram? When did you come? You came earlier than expected?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
玛拉姆？你什么时候来的？比预期来得早啊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Thanks to the adventurer's help, I came a little faster this time.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
多亏了冒险者的帮助，这次我来得快了一些。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Is this the newcomer who just arrived?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
这是刚到的新人吗？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh, that's not it. He is not from around here. He is from a completely different place. He helped with purchasing goods this time, and they've transported them all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
哦，不是。他不是这里的人。他来自完全不同的地方。这次他帮忙采购货物，并把它们一直运到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Hmm... An adventurer...? So, they're an outsider? Are we sure about your identity? What if we search through everything he have?
Or perhaps we could let slip some information over there? If not, what if they try to claim our land like those immigrants?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
嗯...冒险者...？所以，他是外人？我们确定他的身份吗？如果我们搜查他所有的东西呢？
或者，我们可以在那边透露一些信息？如果不这样做，万一他像那些移民一样试图占领我们的土地呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No, not him! He have nothing but kind words for everyone they meet! They're not that kind of person at all. Why would you compare him to those troublemakers?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
不，不是他！他对遇到的每个人都很友善！他根本不是那种人。你为什么要把他和那些麻烦制造者相提并论？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Do you think someone's intentions are written on their face? Whether they're a thief or a military member, that's something we'll find out over time!
Isha brought back a wolf cub, and now, Marem, are you bringing back people?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
你觉得一个人的意图会写在脸上吗？无论是盗贼还是军人，那都是我们要随时间观察的！
伊莎带回来一只狼崽，现在，玛拉姆，你又要带人回来了？

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person, though.
scripts.translation: 我可不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh, of course, what comes out of their mouth isn't the truth. It's just talk, that's all.
By the way, a wolf cub? What wolf cub?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
哦，当然，他们嘴里说出来的话不一定是真的，只是随口说说罢了。
对了，狼崽？什么狼崽？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh! Isha brought back a Baby Grey Wolf from the forest not too long ago! She won't even listen when we tell her to take it back to the woods!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哦！艾莎不久前从普勒斯特带回来一只小灰狼！我们让她把狼崽送回树林，她都不肯听！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Do you know what that means? It's already causing trouble for our sheep! Even now, it's behaving like that. What will happen when it gets bigger? It will definitely harm our sheep!
So, why don't you go and try saying it once! I won't listen to what you say!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
你知道这意味着什么吗？它已经给我们的羊群惹麻烦了！现在它就这样，等它长大了怎么办？肯定会伤害我们的羊！
所以，你为什么不亲自去劝劝她呢！我才不听你那一套！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh? That's actually a great suggestion. It would be a very constructive conversation. But what should I do? I have to tidy up the stuff I brought.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
哦？这倒是个好建议。这会是一次非常有建设性的对话。但我该怎么办呢？我还得整理一下带来的东西。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, of course! Adventurer! Would you care to go? Explore this place, take in the sights, and perhaps make a lasting impression on the locals as well.
Since we'll be staying here for a while anyway, right? Everyone here is as friendly and kind-hearted as I am, so you won't encounter any hostility.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
啊，对了！冒险者！你要不要去看看？探索一下这个地方，欣赏一下风景，顺便也给当地人留下个好印象。
反正我们要在这里住一段时间，对吧？这里的人都很友善，心地善良，就像我一样，你不会遇到任何敌意的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Right, Scania?
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
对吧，斯堪尼亚？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
......

[Maram]
Just go and check whether what Aisha brought back is a real wolf cub or just a puppy that looks like a wolf.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
去确认一下艾莎带回来的是真的狼崽，还是只是一只长得像狼的小狗。

scripts.text: What about verifying it?
scripts.translation: 那要核实一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh... well, I haven't really thought that far. But wouldn't it be troublesome if it's really a wolf cub? Even a puppy would be a hassle in that case.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
哦...嗯，我还没想那么远。但如果真的是狼崽，那不是很麻烦吗？即使是小狗，也会很麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let me explain for our newly arrived adventurer. Here, the land is such that there aren't many animals suitable for raising.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
让我给这位新来的冒险者解释一下。这里的土地环境，并不适合饲养很多动物。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Mostly, Skania takes care of the sheep and chickens. There are hardly any cattle or pigs that can adapt to such places. Therefore, livestock is really precious here.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
通常，斯堪尼亚负责照看羊和小鸡。很少有牛或猪能适应这样的地方。因此，这里的牲畜非常珍贵。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But what if what Aisha is carrying is indeed a wolf cub?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
但如果艾莎带回来的确实是狼崽呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The mother is coming to find her cub!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
狼妈妈会来找她的幼崽！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Even if the mother doesn't come looking for it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
即使狼妈妈不来找它呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The cub will grow up and start harming the livestock!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
狼崽长大后会开始伤害牲畜！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Did you hear?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
你听到了吗？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我该去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Where did Aisha live again? Ah, right! <NAVI>[Upper Side]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, if you go there, you'll find Aisha's house.
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
艾莎住在哪里来着？啊，对了！<NAVI>[上方]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，如果你去那里，就能找到艾莎的家。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But there's no point in saying it, right? If I persuade you, it might change your mind about me too.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
但说了也没用，对吧？如果我劝你，可能会改变你对我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Adventurer, then, please go and return safely! I'll take my leave for now too!
scripts.translation:
[玛拉姆]
冒险者，那就拜托你了，请平安归来！
我也先告辞了！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
<NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, no matter how many times I say it to you, it won't make a difference, will it? If I persuade you, it might change my opinion of you too.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
<NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，无论我说多少遍，对你来说都不会有改变，对吧？
如果我劝你，可能会改变我对你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
<NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for a hundred days won't help? If you convince me, I'll change my opinion of you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
<NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，一百天也不行吗？
如果你能说服我，我会改变对你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Woof woof. Today's walk is over now. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
汪汪。今天的散步结束了。
我太累了。

scripts.text:
[Goat]
Yaaawwwn---
scripts.translation:
[山羊]
咩——

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I can't let you go alone. How can I send you to such a dangerous place alone? Of course, I know you can handle a walk by yourself, but I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
我不能让你一个人去。
怎么能把你一个人送到那么危险的地方呢？
当然，我知道你自己能应付，但我还是担心。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Aisha? Why are you here? Did you come to return the wolf?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
艾莎？你怎么在这里？
你是来送狼回去的吗？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
No, it's not like that. You brought the wolf... with you? In front of the sheep? Are you out of your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
不，不是那样的。
你把狼...带在身边了？
在羊群面前？你疯了吗？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Why on earth are you trying to raise a wolf? Do you need a dog? Then get a dog.
No, I'll just become the dog. I'll mess up your house too and occasionally bite you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
你到底为什么要养狼？
你需要狗吗？那就养只狗。
不，我来当那只狗吧。我也会弄乱你的房子，偶尔还会咬你。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Scania, I heard your wishes loud and clear. So, did you even send a person to me? Are you treating me like some kind of a contractor, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
斯堪尼亚，我听得清清楚楚。那么，你派人来找我了吗？
你把我当成什么承包商了吗，冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Despite all your efforts, so what? This person has already sided with me! Hahaha! Come on, show me that face of despair!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
尽管你费尽心思，那又怎样？
这个人已经站在我这边了！哈哈！
来吧，让我看看你那绝望的表情！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
What? Adventurer? You betrayed me? How could you do that? Betrayal at first sight, isn't that too much? I should have known. Outsiders like you can't be trusted.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
什么？冒险者？你背叛了我？
你怎么能这么做？
一见钟情就背叛，这也太过分了吧？
我早该知道的。像你这样的外人，是不能信任的。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Scania, have you ever been to the Ice Caves? Is the blood flowing in your veins colder than the frozen water there? You cold-blooded one!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
斯堪尼亚，你去过冰洞吗？
你血管里流动的血液，比那里的冰水还冷吗？
你这个冷血动物！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
How can you even suggest sending this small and fragile little creature back to such a dangerous place? Its mother is dead, and it can't survive on its own.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你怎么能建议把这个弱小又脆弱的小家伙送回那么危险的地方？
它的母亲已经死了，它无法独自生存。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Its mother... is gone?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
它的母亲...不在了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I said that, didn't I? I told you a hundred times. You didn't listen again, did you? You just believe what you want to believe, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我说过吧？
我告诉过你一百次了。
你又不听，对吧？
你只相信你想相信的，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I don't know about you, but I can't bear to send this small and fragile young wolf back to the market.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我不知道你怎么想，但我无法忍受把这个弱小又脆弱的幼狼送回市场。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But if that wolf grows up, our sheep...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
但如果那只狼长大了，我们的羊...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Don't worry about that. Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
别担心那个。冒险者？

scripts.text: Oh, do I need to talk about it?
scripts.translation: 哦，我需要谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You won't listen to me anyway. You never listen to me when I talk, and you only believe what other people say.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
反正你也不会听我的。我说话你从来不听，只相信别人说的话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This wolf cub will be fine if it is trained. If it grows up with other friends from a young age, it will not harm them and will instead protect the sheep.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这只狼崽如果好好训练就没问题。如果从小和其他伙伴一起长大，它不仅不会伤害它们，反而会保护羊群。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Did you hear me? Where is your refutation? Come on, smart genius! Sit down! Hands up!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你听见了吗？你的反驳呢？快点，聪明的天才！坐下！举起手！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
It's true. But... but I don't know how long it will last... I don't know if it will be able to suppress its wild nature...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
确实如此。但是...我不知道能维持多久...我不知道它能否压制住野性...

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But most of all, I don't think you'll be able to train it that patiently.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
但最重要的是，我觉得你不可能那么有耐心地训练它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll help you with any nervousness so you can be fully trained. I'll take him for walks so we can bond.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会帮你克服它的紧张情绪，让它得到充分训练。我会带它散步，让我们建立感情。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You said it was hard to keep chasing after the cub when he went for walks alone. Isn't this a good thing?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你说过它独自散步时很难追上。这不是好事吗？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Are you sure you can take care of our wolf cub? I'm worried about him being outside with all the dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
你确定能照顾好我们的狼崽吗？外面有很多危险的魔物，我很担心它。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
See those calluses on your hands, Adventurer? You said Maram brought him here, so he must be trustworthy. He's a veteran we trained in minutes!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
看看你手上的老茧，冒险者？你说玛拉姆把它带到这里，那它一定很可靠。它是我们在几分钟内训练出来的老兵！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh, well... I can't help coming all the way here, so can I ask you a favor? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哎呀...既然都跑到这里来了，能帮我个忙吗？呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You're so excited, like you've been waiting for this moment. Aren't you taking it too cold?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你太兴奋了，好像一直在等待这一刻。你难道不觉得太冷淡了吗？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh no~ You're so~ desperately~ asking!! So, I can't help but...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哎呀~你真是~拼命~地请求啊！！所以，我不得不...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Anyway... I need to talk to the villagers about the cub. Our little one is safe! Let's go, little cub!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
总之...我需要和村民们谈谈狼崽的事。我们的小家伙安全了！走吧，小狼崽！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh... suddenly became a temporary shepherd, huh...? Thank you. I had a lot to do. What can I do to help?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哦...突然成了临时牧羊人，是吗...？谢谢你。我有很多事要做。我能怎么帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ah, right! Outsiders often like these sorts of things. Do you like it, adventurer? Even if you don't, you can exchange it for something you like with someone who does. Take it with you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
啊，对了！外来者通常喜欢这种东西。你喜欢吗，冒险者？即使你不喜欢，也可以找喜欢它的人交换成你喜欢的东西。带上它吧。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dffYou receive favorable evaluations.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
好的，散步时见。
^4d4dff你获得了良好的评价。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼的村民们已接纳你为村庄的一员。^000000
你有资格参加^4d4dff会议。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dffYou receive favorable evaluations.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
好的，散步时见。
^4d4dff你获得了良好的评价。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Please wait the end of the quest delay.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
请等待任务冷却结束。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
冒险者，你辛苦了。我觉得我们的狗也很满意。你吃得开心吗？那么，请明天再来吧！
^4d4dff灰狼的村民们已接纳你为村庄的一员。^000000
你有资格参加^4d4dff会议。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
冒险者，你辛苦了。我觉得我们的狗也很满意。你吃得开心吗？那么，请明天再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
There are a few places the dog likes, and I will guide you. You only need to deal with dangerous monsters nearby.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
狗有几个喜欢的地方，我会带你去。你只需要处理附近的危险魔物。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
It's a pain in the ass because ashrings rush in. Please take care of the surrounding ashrings. I usually catch 20 eagles a day. Then please.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
因为灰烬精灵总是冲过来，真是麻烦。请处理一下周围的灰烬精灵。我通常每天能抓到20只鹰。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, I came on time for our walk. But Aisha didn't show up...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
冒险者，我准时来散步了。但是艾莎没有出现...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Ta-da! We're here!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
当当！我们到了！

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof!!
scripts.translation:
[福实]
汪！！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, I'll take you for a walk. Really... do I have to go too? Can I trust you to handle it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
好的，我带你去散步。真是的...我也必须去吗？能信任你处理好吗？

scripts.text: Alright then.
scripts.translation: 那就拜托了

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天有点忙

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ah... I see... You're busy. Well, then there's nothing to be done about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
啊...我知道了...你很忙。那也没办法了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh, come on, look at my disappointed face. There's nothing I can do. Today, come with me. Well then, goodbye, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
哎呀，看看我失望的脸。我也没办法。今天跟我来吧。那么，再见，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
If you're worried, you can come along.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
如果你担心，可以一起来。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
h, no. Alright then, I'll leave it to you. Take care, pup. If you're worried or don't like it, let me know and come home. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
嗯，不。好吧，那就交给你了。小心点，小家伙。如果你担心或不喜欢，告诉我并回家。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Goat]
Yahaaaaawwwn---
scripts.translation:
[山羊]
咩啊啊啊——

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. He can find and eat on his own, so just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
我会带你去几个小家伙喜欢的地方。它能自己找到并吃，所以只需处理附近的危险魔物。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
灰烬精灵总是成群结队，让人头疼...请处理附近的灰烬精灵。我们通常每天能抓到大约20只。所以，请帮我处理一下。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. Just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
我会带你去几个小家伙喜欢的地方。只需处理附近的危险魔物。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亚]
灰烬精灵总是成群结队，让人头疼...请处理附近的灰烬精灵。我们通常每天能抓到大约20只。所以，请帮我处理一下。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
We need to show Scania that our Boksil is safe and reliable!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我们需要向斯堪尼亚证明我们的福实是安全可靠的！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do you want to see wolf cub poop? How cute is it? Oh, but don't touch it.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你想看狼崽的便便吗？多可爱啊？哦，但是别碰它。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil~ Let's live together forever with me. If someone comes to harm you, I will personally bury them in the Oz Maze. So don't worry, Wolf Cub~ Just trust me and let's live happily.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福实~ 让我永远和你一起生活。如果有人来伤害你，我会亲自把他们埋在奥兹迷宫。所以别担心，狼崽~ 相信我，让我们幸福地生活。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof---
scripts.translation:
[福实]
汪——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
No, Boksil. Calm down a bit. Oh dear. What will happen if you still act unfamiliar? No, I'm not saying anything to you... Let's get closer, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
不，福实。冷静一点。哎呀。如果你还是这么生疏怎么办？不，我什么都没说... 我们靠近一点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roaarrrr---
scripts.translation:
[福实]
嗷呜——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I understand, I understand. You need some time alone. Honestly, I feel the same way. In the end, we're all alone in this world. So let's live well on our own while still living together.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我懂，我懂。你需要独处的时间。说实话，我也这么觉得。毕竟，在这个世界上我们终究都是孤独的。所以，让我们各自安好，同时一起生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roarrrrrr---
scripts.translation:
[福实]
嗷呜——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Why? What did I do...... Huh? Who are you? I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
为什么？我做了什么...... 咦？你是谁？我从来没见过你。

scripts.text: So this is the wolf cub?
scripts.translation: 原来这就是狼崽？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Don't get too close to my wolf cub. Put your hands down. Turn around and disappear.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
别靠近我的狼崽。把手放下。转过身去，消失吧。

scripts.text: I'm not a bad guy...
scripts.translation: 我不是坏人...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I don't call anyone a bad people. Anyone who tells me to abandon my wolf cub is a villain. And I show no mercy to villains.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我不叫任何人坏人。任何让我抛弃狼崽的人都是恶棍。而且我对恶棍绝不心慈手软。

scripts.text: How long have you been here?
scripts.translation: 你在这里多久了？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I can't disclose that as it's personal information. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
这是个人隐私，我不能透露。你为什么这么问？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, this wolf cub, I don't think he's trained yet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，这只狼崽，我觉得它还没经过训练。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
... No, that's. She's about a month old now. There's no way she can train while she's still a baby.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
... 不，那是。她现在大约一个月大。还是婴儿的时候，怎么可能接受训练呢。

scripts.text: Actually, I'm here to...
scripts.translation: 其实，我是来...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
What? I knew it! Get at least 10 paces away from my wolf cub right now. Don't come any closer.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
什么？我就知道！立刻离我的狼崽至少十步远。不要靠近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am not here to take her, I am here to check on here... If she separated from the pack, we have to put them back, and we have to be prepared for the mother wolf to come looking for them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来带走它的，我是来查看情况的... 如果它脱离了狼群，我们必须把它送回去，并且要做好母狼回来寻找它的准备。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
She's not stray out of the pack, she was picked up next to next to its dying mother wolf.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
它不是脱离狼群的流浪儿，它是在即将死去的母狼身边被捡到的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops. It's probably nervous about being separated from his mother and living in a strange place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀。它可能是因为与母亲分离，又生活在陌生的地方而感到紧张。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Are you sure you're not here to take her away, then why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你确定你不是来带走它的，那你来这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did come to persuade after confirming whether it was indeed a wolf cub...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我确实是在确认那是否真的是狼崽之后，才来劝说你的...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I knew it! Sent by Scania, right? Why are you meddling with other people's pets? Our wolf cub isn't dangerous, so go back. There's nothing more to see.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我就知道！是斯堪尼亚派你来的吧？为什么要干涉别人的宠物？我们的狼崽并不危险，所以请回去吧。没什么好看的了。

scripts.text: As long as you're careful, there's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation: 只要小心一点，就没有什么好担心的。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do you really think so? Do you really think our wolf cub could be a potential threat? Look at how small and cute she is...
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你真的这么认为吗？你真的认为我们的狼崽可能会成为威胁吗？看看她多小多可爱...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might have thought so under normal circumstances, but... if she doesn't have a mother, at least there wouldn't be any reason for wolves to come here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在正常情况下你可能这么想，但是...如果她没有母亲，至少狼群就没有理由来这里了。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I understand what you're saying! But stupid Scania doesn't know that! Even a complete stranger like you understands my heart so well!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我明白你的意思！但愚蠢的斯堪尼亚不懂！连你这样的陌生人都能如此理解我的心意！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Moreover, this motherless wolf cub wouldn't be able to survive on its own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，这只失去母亲的狼崽是无法独自生存的。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
That's right! That cold-hearted one has turned ice-cold right down to the head.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
没错！那个冷血的人，心都冷得像冰一样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, for Boksil to live in the village, she needs training. She must learn how to interact with others without causing harm and how to get along.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，为了让福实在村庄里生活，她需要接受训练。她必须学会如何与他人互动而不造成伤害，以及如何与人相处。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
She is still so young...?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
她还这么小...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It should be done when she's young. If we start training it from a young age, there won't be any of the concerns the villagers have.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
应该趁她年幼时进行训练。如果从小开始训练，就不会有村民们担心的那些问题了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Firm tone, immediate response, and sufficient praise will be enough for it to understand well. Wolves are smart, you know. What does wolf cub like the most?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
坚定的语气、及时的回应和充分的表扬就足以让她理解得很好。狼是很聪明的，你知道吗。狼崽最喜欢什么？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Hm... Meat? But there isn't any right now. Do adventurers have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
嗯...肉？但现在没有肉。冒险者身上有吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh...! There's no meat to give as a snack, meat... I need to bring some meat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...！没有肉可以当零食，肉...我需要带些肉来。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
How are you supposed to train with meat? You only need one?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你打算怎么用肉来训练？只需要一块吗？

scripts.text:

- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！ -
- 您当前携带的物品 -
- 数量过多。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再次尝试。 -

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Oh, don't touch our Boksil! She doesn't like it!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
哦，别碰我们的福实！她不喜欢这样！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Didn't you say you needed a chunk of meat? is not it?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你不是说需要一块肉吗？不是吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~ I am {1}. Your name is Boksil, right? Nice to meet you. Are you feeling anxious in this unfamiliar place? I know exactly how you feel, I know everything about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好~ 我是{1}。你的名字是福实，对吧？很高兴见到你。在这个陌生的地方感到焦虑吗？我完全知道你的感受，我了解你的一切。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roarrr---

[{0}]
But it's okay. Everything's fine. There's no one here who would harm our Boksil. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但没关系。一切都好。这里没有人会伤害我们的福实。别担心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now we're all living together. With a warm shelter and delicious food to eat.
Then we need to establish some rules. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在我们住在一起了。有温暖的住所和美味的食物。
那么我们需要制定一些规则，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof?
scripts.translation:
[福实]
汪？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I feel like I'm talking to a child.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我觉得我在跟小孩子说话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, look. Meat. Does Boksil like meat? Grilled, raw, or boiled? You've never tried grilled? That's okay, you'll have plenty of opportunities to try it in the future.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，这是肉。福实喜欢肉吗？烤的、生的还是煮的？你从来没吃过烤的？没关系，以后你会有很多机会尝试的。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[福实]
汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's do it right.
Boksil, sit down!
Wait!
Well done. Here is your meat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们要好好做。
福实，坐下！
等一下！
做得好。这是你的肉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you see? If she follows instructions like this, please give her a lot of praise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看到了吗？如果她能像这样听从指令，请多表扬她。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Mom, Mom. Isn't our child a real genius?
Our Boksil did a great job!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
妈妈，妈妈。我们的孩子真是个天才吧？
我们的福实做得太棒了！！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We need to keep doing this until she gets used to it. Repetitive training is important. Just keep doing it like you're doing now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们需要继续这样做，直到她习惯为止。重复训练很重要。就像现在这样继续做下去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Boksil, sit.
Hand.
Wait. Now, try it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
福实，坐下。
握手。
等一下。现在，你自己试试。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil, sit!
Hand!
Wow, that's really amazing.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福实，坐下！
握手！
哇，这真的很厉害。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Training these kinds of domestic animals varies. Making them feel secure in this place and building a good bond with them will help them settle in well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
训练这类家畜各有不同。让她们在这个地方感到安全，并与她们建立良好关系，有助于她们更好地适应。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And if they also interact with other friends and spend time together from a young age, they should get along well without any major issues.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且如果她们从小与其他朋友互动并一起度过时光，她们应该能相处得很好，不会有太大问题。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do people recognize that?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
人们能意识到这一点吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You just need to show them what you've done. It shows that Boksil is ready to live as a member of this village.
Let's go back to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and show off our wonderful and majestic Boksil.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你只需要展示你做了什么。这表明福实已经准备好作为这个村庄的一员生活了。
让我们回到<NAVI>[斯堪尼亚]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，展示我们美丽而高贵的福实。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil is cute. But we're going to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right? Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福实很可爱。但我们要去<NAVI>[斯堪尼亚]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>对吧？别忘了。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Why are you eavesdropping on other people's conversations?
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
你们为什么在偷听别人的谈话？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Uh, once again at the village meeting, all they did was talk nonsense, that old man.
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
呃，再次在村民会议上，那个老人只会胡说八道。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
That old man? Ah, the one whose name cannot be mentioned?
scripts.translation:
[红细胞]
那个老人？啊，就是那个不能提名字的人？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I mean, I can't mention it.
I heard he was someone important in Rahel, said to have some influence in the Gray Wolf Forest.
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
我的意思是，我不能提他的名字。
我听说他是拉赫尔的重要人物，据说在灰狼森林有一定影响力。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
That old man, whether it's Ahap or Ahab!
He doesn't act like that when he's in Rachel~ He must have messed up~
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
那个老头，不管是阿哈还是亚哈！
他在拉赫的时候可不是这样的~ 他肯定搞砸了~

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
If that's the case, why bother coming here instead of staying in Rachel?
I really don't understand!
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
既然这样，为什么不去拉赫待着，非要来这里？
我真的不明白！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Does she still not realize she's in Rachel?
Even sleeping in a drafty tent, hasn't she woken up from her dream yet?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
她难道还没意识到自己身在拉赫吗？
即使在漏风的帐篷里睡觉，她也没能从梦中醒来吗？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
If you want to dream, do it alone.
Why bother others with your troubles?
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
如果你想做梦，就自己去做。
为什么要拿自己的烦恼去打扰别人？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Who do you think you are, eavesdropping on our conversation?
Are you the Ahab old man's spy?
scripts.translation:
[红细胞]
你以为你是谁，在这里偷听我们的谈话？
你是亚哈那个老头的间谍吗？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
You're not even smart enough to cultivate weeds like Ahab.
So, who are you? Eavesdropping on others' gossip. Shameful.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你连像亚哈那样培育杂草的本事都没有。
所以，你是谁？偷听别人的八卦。真丢人。

scripts.text: Just a passing traveler.
scripts.translation: 只是一个路过的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Liar. Where's a passing traveler in this Gray Wolf Forest?
They must be related to us somehow.
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
骗子。在灰狼森林里哪有路过的旅行者？
他们肯定和我们有什么关系。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If you won't speak, we'll have to use force to make you.
Are you really just going to keep lying?
scripts.translation:
[红细胞]
如果你不肯说话，我们就得用武力让你开口。
你真的打算一直撒谎吗？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Calm down, Redcell. Even if Zlan is not a passing traveler, there could still be someone here we don't know about but wouldn't be out of place.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
冷静点，红细胞。即使兹兰不是路过的旅行者，这里可能还有我们不知道但也不突兀的人。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Who would that be?
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
那是谁？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Now that Ahab is starting to listen to people... He doesn't seem like such a bad person after all.
Yeah, that's just how adults communicate.
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
现在亚哈开始听别人说话了... 他似乎并不是个坏人。
是的，这就是成年人沟通的方式。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
It's a relief that they don't end up causing too much trouble by just blocking each other's ears and shouting
Thanks to you. I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
幸好他们没有因为互相堵耳朵和喊叫而惹出大麻烦。
多亏了你。我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
You're back? What did Ahab say?
What? He said he'll start listening to others now?
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
你回来了？亚哈说了什么？
什么？他说他以后会听别人说话了？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I guess he hasn't been listening until now.
scripts.translation:
[兹兰]
看来他之前一直没在听。

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
Hmph... Don't tease, Zlan.
What matters now is that he's decided to do it properly.
scripts.translation:
[卡亚尔]
哼... 别取笑我了，兹兰。
现在重要的是他决定好好做了。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Ya, ya.
Why did Dah... I mean, Ahab change his mind?
You must have convinced him, being a high-ranking or well-connected person.
scripts.translation:
[红细胞]
是，是。
为什么达... 我是说，亚哈改变了主意？
你一定是个地位很高或很有关系的人，说服了他。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Thanks to you, we don't have to kick people out of here anymore.
Even though he said he'd do it, it was still uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[红细胞]
多亏了你，我们不用再赶人走了。
虽然他说他会做，但还是让人不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
I may not be a representative at the village meetings... but we'll show some courtesy.
We're lucky to have someone like you.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡亚尔]
我可能不是村民会议的代表... 但我们会表示一些礼貌。
有像你这样的人是我们的幸运。
 
^4d4dff对你进行了一次有利的评价。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼的村民们已接受你成为村庄的一员。^000000
你有资格参加^4d4dff会议。^000000

scripts.translation:

我可能不是村民会议的代表... 但我们会表示一些礼貌。
有像你这样的人是我们的幸运。
